messages:
alex: Heads up — rolling private installer bundle v1.9.3 to private-vpc tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Tagging images, cosign signing, and publishing sealed manifest. ETA ~30m for full promotion. @maria @grant please confirm artifacts and multi-arch coverage.

maria: Ack. Packaging ran locally, shrinkwrap pushed as `v1.9.3-shrink`. Size looks good.

grant: Checked artifact hashes against the mirror list, all match. Do we want cosign signatures from the new signer pool? KMS TTLs ok?

anya: KMS TTLs are fine (rotated last Wed). Cosign key is in signer pool; I'll generate a proof bundle and upload to signer-store.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: deploybot will start at 02:00 UTC. Canary window 10m; canary hosts: 2 in eu-west-1. Auto-rollback triggers: cosign mismatch OR >20% 5xx during canary. Run id: run-2026-03-22-02.

maria: Note for airgap transfers: I'm enabling delta chunking (`MIRROR_CHUNKS=4`) to reduce retry cost. Ops should reserve transfer window + extra 15m.

lia: ops: transfer window reserved 02:30–03:15 UTC. Keep total artifact <6GB or transfer bot will timeout on some customers. Ping me if we need to extend.

grant: One more thing — the image `sha256:abcd1234` currently lacks an arm64 manifest entry. Private onprem fleets use arm64 too. Do we push arm64 or fallback to qemu multi-arch manifest?

alex: Good catch. maria, can you push arm64? If not, fallback will add ~6m to build time.

maria: Pushing arm64 now to the registry mirror. ETA ~4m — will update the manifest list once done.

deploy-bot: Canary started (run-2026-03-22-02) -> 2/2 canaries reported healthy so far. Will hold for full 10m unless @lia aborts.

lia: Will monitor the transfer. Abort if network errors >1/10 or any cosign verify failure reported. Also please remind integrator teams to pin their installer manifest to `v1.9.3` — several were still referencing `latest` in staging.

grant: Clarifying rollback conditions: immediate rollback if cosign verification fails OR >25% failures in `install-step:download` across canaries OR image hash mismatch on any canary. Rollback action: flip `installer-pin` back to `v1.9.2` and notify customers.

alex: :thumbsup: Drafted release notes (internal): https://internal.redwood/release-notes/1.9.3 — includes airgap notes, cosign proof location, and rollback criteria. DM for edits.

ci-bot: Preflight checks summary:
```
checks: checksum OK
cosign: OK
manifest: multi-arch OK (amd64, arm64)
mirror-size: 5.8GB
```

lia: Transfer completed. Saw a single retry at 02:36 but within thresholds — proceeding to promote.

deploy-bot: Promote started -> 02:41 UTC. Artifact promotion run-2026-03-22-02 completed. Delta pin flip: `installer-pin` -> `v1.9.3`. Notifications sent to private customers.

anya: Running post-deploy smoke in eu-west-1 (connectivity, auth, basic deploy hooks). Will ping when done.

maria: Smoke passed (smoke id 2026-03-22-02-smoke). Logging final note: "airgap shim included, multi-arch images present, cosign proof attached to signer-store/2026-03-22/v1.9.3"

alex: Thanks all. If anything breaks, open #incidents and mention @eng-releases. Closing this window unless someone requests a hold.
